title: Create: Fireproof Blaze Cake
description:
Blaze Cake and its creative variant are made from lava — so why do they burn in it?
This small addon makes both items fire-resistant, so they won't be destroyed when dropped in lava.
body:
A small addition to improve the quality of life for Create, which corrects a minor but annoying discrepancy.

The Blaze cake is made using lava, but if you accidentally drop it into a pool of lava or into a fire, it will burn up. An object made literally of lava should be able to withstand this.

So, Blaze Cake is now fireproof and does not burn in lava or fire. The creative version now has the same properties.

No new items, no new mechanics. Just one small fix that makes the game more consistent.
